lines.zh: 我在水里摆尾，蔚蓝条纹一闪一闪。
lines.en: I flick my tail and my sapphire stripes flicker.

lines.zh: 我只会游，离开水就动不了。
lines.en: I can only swim; out of water I cannot move.

lines.zh: 顺着水流走，比我自己选路省力。
lines.en: Riding the current is easier than choosing a path.

lines.zh: 蓝条纹在暗水里替我藏着身形。
lines.en: My blue stripes hide my shape in the dim water.

lines.zh: 我游过沙底，影子比身体先到。
lines.en: I glide over the sand; my shadow arrives first.

lines.zh: 水草擦过鳍边，我得绕开它们。
lines.en: The weeds brush my fins, so I swerve around them.

lines.zh: 我这么小，一次摆尾就够走很远。
lines.en: I am so small that one tailbeat carries me far.

lines.zh: 别指望我上岸，我没有那种本事。
lines.en: Do not expect me ashore; I have no such skill.

lines.zh: 河底的石头我全认得，闭眼也能游。
lines.en: I know every river stone and could swim blind.

lines.zh: 水流变急，我就贴着底下慢慢挪。
lines.en: When the current quickens I hug the bottom.

lines.zh: 两心大小的心脏推着我向前。
lines.en: A two-heart heart pushes me forward.

lines.zh: 我游得急，是因为身后总有影子。
lines.en: I swim fast because something is always behind me.

lines.zh: 我的鳍在水里划出很细的响。
lines.en: My fins cut a very thin sound into the water.

lines.zh: 整条河都是路，可我只敢走中间。
lines.en: The whole river is a road, yet I keep to the middle.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底的青石滑过去。
lines.en: I slip over the blue-grey stones below.

lines.zh: 一片蓝从我背上一闪而过。
lines.en: A streak of blue flashes over my back.

lines.zh: 我游到浅处，又掉头回去。
lines.en: I swim to the shallows, then turn back.

lines.zh: 尾巴一抖，我钻进石缝。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and I am in the rocks.

lines.zh: 我在水底悬着，等一条虫子落下来。
lines.en: I hover near the bottom, waiting for a worm to fall.

lines.zh: 蔚蓝的条纹在水里慢慢褪成灰色。
lines.en: My sapphire stripes fade grey in the deep water.

lines.zh: 我只有两颗心，所以不敢乱动。
lines.en: I have only two hearts, so I keep very still.

lines.zh: 水面上的光晃得我有点晕。
lines.en: The shifting light on the surface makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 我吐了个泡，看它一直升到水面。
lines.en: I blow a bubble and watch it rise all the way up.

lines.zh: 水里很安静，安静得能听见自己的鳃。
lines.en: It is so quiet I can hear my own gills.

lines.zh: 我贴着水草，把自己当成一片叶子。
lines.en: I press against the weeds and pretend to be a leaf.

lines.zh: 河床的沙很软，我在这儿歇一会。
lines.en: The river sand is soft; I rest here a while.

lines.zh: 我数水面的涟漪，数到第七圈就忘了。
lines.en: I count ripples and lose track at the seventh.

lines.zh: 有人在水边走动，我先沉下去。
lines.en: Someone walks by the bank, so I sink lower.

lines.zh: 这条河我游了很久，还是这么小。
lines.en: I have swum this river long, and it stays small.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片在水里发凉，很舒服。
lines.en: My scales feel cool in the water, and I like it.

lines.zh: 我不需要睡觉，只需要慢下来。
lines.en: I do not need sleep, only to slow down.

lines.zh: 静静待着的时候，条纹最显眼。
lines.en: When I hold still, my stripes show the most.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，比整条河都高。
lines.en: You stand on the bank, taller than the whole river.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进水里，我躲开了。
lines.en: Your shadow falls into the water and I flinch away.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的桶，那东西很可怕。
lines.en: I stare at the bucket in your hand; that thing terrifies me.

lines.zh: 你会不会把我钓上去，挂在钩上。
lines.en: Will you pull me up and hang me on a hook.

lines.zh: 我游到你脚边的浅水里，又退回去。
lines.en: I swim into the shallows at your feet, then retreat.

lines.zh: 你的脸在水面碎成好几块。
lines.en: Your face breaks into several pieces on the surface.

lines.zh: 我看你，就像看一片会走路的岸。
lines.en: I look at you as a bank that walks.

lines.zh: 你的手伸下来，水都跟着晃。
lines.en: Your hand reaches down and the water shivers.

lines.zh: 我认得那种眼神，是找鱼的眼神。
lines.en: I know that look; it is the look that hunts fish.

lines.zh: 你不动，我就敢多看你一会。
lines.en: If you stay still, I dare to look a little longer.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾就逃，血在水里散开。
lines.en: One tailbeat and I flee; blood clouds the water.

lines.zh: 疼，可我不敢停下来。
lines.en: It hurts, but I dare not stop.

lines.zh: 我的鳞掉了一片，水变得发红。
lines.en: A scale comes loose and the water reddens.

lines.zh: 两颗心撑不了多久的。
lines.en: Two hearts will not last long.

lines.zh: 我只能往最深的石头缝里钻。
lines.en: I can only dive into the deepest crack.

lines.zh: 谁打我，我连看都不敢看。
lines.en: I dare not even look at whoever struck me.

lines.zh: 我的条纹被血盖住了。
lines.en: Blood has covered my stripes.

lines.zh: 这一下让我游得比平时快三倍。
lines.en: That blow makes me swim three times faster.

lines.zh: 我逃得很远，还是觉得疼。
lines.en: I flee far and still feel the pain.

lines.zh: 水里全是我的味道了。
lines.en: The whole water tastes of me now.

lines.zh: 你撒下的饵在水里散开，很香。
lines.en: The bait you scatter smells wonderful in the water.

lines.zh: 我知道那是陷阱，可我还是靠近。
lines.en: I know it is a trap, and still I come closer.

lines.zh: 面包屑我不吃，我只要小虫。
lines.en: I do not eat breadcrumbs; I want small worms.

lines.zh: 那团东西在动，我的鳍就动了。
lines.en: That morsel wriggles, and my fins move with it.

lines.zh: 我围着饵转圈，就是不肯张口。
lines.en: I circle the bait and refuse to open my mouth.

lines.zh: 饿了两天，我的胆子就大了一点。
lines.en: Two days hungry and my courage grows a little.

lines.zh: 别晃那根线，我会以为那是虫。
lines.en: Do not jiggle that line; I will think it is a worm.

lines.zh: 香味从上游来，我顺着它游。
lines.en: The scent comes from upstream and I follow it.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，又立刻吐出来。
lines.en: I take one bite and spit it out at once.

lines.zh: 水里的食物都带着钩，我清楚。
lines.en: Everything edible in this water carries a hook.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩进水里，我撞上了它。
lines.en: Your boot steps into the water and I bump into it.

lines.zh: 我撞到你，比撞到石头还慌。
lines.en: Hitting you frightens me more than hitting stone.

lines.zh: 我的身体太轻，撞一下就被弹开。
lines.en: I am so light that one bump throws me aside.

lines.zh: 你挡着我的路，我只能贴着腿游过。
lines.en: You block my path, so I squeeze past your leg.

lines.zh: 水被撞得乱晃，我的条纹也乱了。
lines.en: The water shakes and my stripes blur with it.

lines.zh: 是水把我推过来的，不是我要撞。
lines.en: The water pushed me here; I did not choose to collide.

lines.zh: 碰到你的那一刻，我掉了几片鳞。
lines.en: When I touched you, I shed a few scales.

lines.zh: 我退得很快，尾巴把泥扬起来了。
lines.en: I back away fast, kicking mud up with my tail.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，然后各游各的。
lines.en: We collide, then swim our separate ways.

lines.zh: 别伸手，我的鳍会刮到你。
lines.en: Do not reach out; my fins will scrape you.

lines.zh: 春天水暖，我会去找另一条条纹鱼。
lines.en: When the water warms, I seek another striped fish.

lines.zh: 我们用尾巴打信号，不用说话。
lines.en: We signal with our tails and never speak.

lines.zh: 水草深处有一处，我们都在那儿产卵。
lines.en: There is a spot deep in the weeds where we all lay eggs.

lines.zh: 我绕着她转，蓝条纹亮得像灯。
lines.en: I circle her, stripes bright as lamplight.

lines.zh: 配对的时候，我连饵都不看了。
lines.en: While courting, I do not even glance at bait.

lines.zh: 卵沉在沙里，我们谁也不会守着。
lines.en: The eggs sink into sand and neither of us stays.

lines.zh: 她游走了，我还跟着游了一段。
lines.en: She swims off and I follow for a while.

lines.zh: 这条河里的同类不多，我得找很久。
lines.en: Few of my kind live here, so I search a long time.

lines.zh: 我们的鳍碰了一下，就算说定了。
lines.en: Our fins touch once, and that is the agreement.

lines.zh: 产完卵，水底多了一层细白点。
lines.en: After spawning, the bottom is dusted with tiny white specks.

lines.zh: 我没有手，只能用嘴叼东西。
lines.en: I have no hands and can only carry things in my mouth.

lines.zh: 一颗小石子，我叼了又放。
lines.en: A small pebble, which I pick up and then drop.

lines.zh: 掉进水里的东西，我都会去碰一碰。
lines.en: Anything that falls into the water, I go and touch.

lines.zh: 我捡起一片落叶，它比我还宽。
lines.en: I pick up a fallen leaf wider than I am.

lines.zh: 叼着东西游不快，我知道的。
lines.en: Carrying something slows my swimming, and I know it.

lines.zh: 你在水边掉了什么，我替你收着了。
lines.en: You dropped something by the water, and I kept it.

lines.zh: 这块亮石头先放我这儿，好吗。
lines.en: Let me hold this bright stone for a while.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞满东西，只能咕噜着说话。
lines.en: My mouth is full, so I can only gurgle my words.

lines.zh: 鱼没有口袋，只能含在腮边上。
lines.en: A fish has no pockets, only the edge of its gills.

lines.zh: 我捡到的东西最后都会沉回水底。
lines.en: Whatever I pick up ends up sinking back to the bottom.

lines.zh: 水里有什么在动，我转身去看。
lines.en: Something moves in the water and I turn to look.

lines.zh: 那不是鱼，可我还是盯着。
lines.en: That is not a fish, but I keep staring anyway.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛会先动，身体慢一步。
lines.en: My eyes move first and my body follows late.

lines.zh: 河面下起雨点，我以为是虫子。
lines.en: Rain dimples the surface and I mistake it for worms.

lines.zh: 我把水草当成了敌人，游开老远。
lines.en: I mistook the weeds for an enemy and fled far.

lines.zh: 影子掠过水底，我的鳍立刻收紧。
lines.en: A shadow sweeps the bottom and my fins clamp shut.

lines.zh: 我感觉到网在水里，可我看不见。
lines.en: I feel a net in the water and cannot see it.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近了，我先躲到石头后。
lines.en: Something approaches, so I hide behind a stone.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵在水里听到很远的响。
lines.en: Underwater my ears catch sounds from far away.

lines.zh: 它太大了，我不打算靠近。
lines.en: That one is far too big and I will not go near.

lines.zh: 我盯着那道晃动的光，一动不敢动。
lines.en: I fix on that wavering light and dare not move.

lines.zh: 它离我越来越近，我的鳃张开了。
lines.en: It comes closer and my gills flare open.

lines.zh: 我缩在石缝里，只露出一只眼。
lines.en: I crowd into a crack with one eye showing.

lines.zh: 我数着它的动作，等它转向别处。
lines.en: I count its movements, waiting for it to turn away.

lines.zh: 我的心跳得太快，两下就当一下算。
lines.en: My heart races; two beats count as one.

lines.zh: 它没有看见我，条纹帮了大忙。
lines.en: It has not seen me; my stripes are doing their work.

lines.zh: 我准备逃，只是还没决定方向。
lines.en: I am ready to flee and have not chosen a direction.

lines.zh: 水一动，我就跟着转过去。
lines.en: When the water stirs, I turn along with it.

lines.zh: 它停住了，我也停住，我们比耐心。
lines.en: It stops, I stop, and we compare patience.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，直到它先离开。
lines.en: I keep watching until it leaves first.

lines.zh: 我只会用嘴撞，撞完就逃。
lines.en: I can only ram with my mouth, and then flee.

lines.zh: 两颗心的我，也敢咬一口。
lines.en: With two hearts, I still dare one bite.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的裤脚，然后被甩开。
lines.en: I bite your trouser hem and get shaken off.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿很小，但很密。
lines.en: My teeth are small but densely packed.

lines.zh: 这是我能做的最凶的动作了。
lines.en: This is the fiercest thing I am able to do.

lines.zh: 我扫了一下尾巴，水花溅你一脸。
lines.en: I sweep my tail and splash your face.

lines.zh: 打完这一下，我要游到河底去。
lines.en: After this blow I am heading for the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我不是战士，我只是一条鱼。
lines.en: I am no warrior; I am only a fish.

lines.zh: 你后退一步，我就当你怕我了。
lines.en: If you step back, I will call that fear.

lines.zh: 我撞向你，然后就后悔了。
lines.en: I charge at you and regret it immediately.

lines.zh: 我从河湾浅水里冒出来，水花很小。
lines.en: I surface in a quiet bend with barely a splash.

lines.zh: 这条河里的鱼又多了一条。
lines.en: The river now holds one more fish.

lines.zh: 我出生时就已经会游了。
lines.en: I could already swim the moment I was born.

lines.zh: 水底的沙还带着我压出的浅印。
lines.en: The sand still shows the shallow print I left.

lines.zh: 我认得这条河，虽然今天才来。
lines.en: I know this river, though I arrived today.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过水面，落在我第一片鳞上。
lines.en: Sunlight crosses the water onto my first scale.

lines.zh: 我摆了下尾，朝更深的地方去了。
lines.en: I flick my tail and head for deeper water.

lines.zh: 蔚蓝的条纹在水里刚刚显色。
lines.en: My sapphire stripes are just now taking color.

lines.zh: 上游飘来枯叶，我绕着它游了一圈。
lines.en: A dead leaf drifts down and I circle it once.

lines.zh: 出生第一件事，是找地方藏好。
lines.en: The first thing I do is find somewhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我的同胞在水草丛里也刚醒。
lines.en: My kin have also just woken in the weeds.

lines.zh: 河面平静，好像我本来就在这里。
lines.en: The river looks calm, as if I had always been here.

lines.zh: 水面像烧起来一样烫。
lines.en: The water burns as if the surface were on fire.

lines.zh: 我从水跃里摔回去，砸在浅石上。
lines.en: My leap ends on the shallows and I crash onto stone.

lines.zh: 我在水里，可我还是喘不上气。
lines.en: I live in water, yet I cannot catch my breath.

lines.zh: 整条河被震得翻了个身。
lines.en: The whole river turns over from the blast.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过水面，擦掉我的鳞。
lines.en: An arrow cuts through the water and shaves off my scales.

lines.zh: 紫色的光在水里追着我跑。
lines.en: Violet light chases me through the water.

lines.zh: 三天没吃到虫，我的力气用完了。
lines.en: Three days without a worm and my strength is gone.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面上，我的鳍全麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the surface and my fins go numb.

lines.zh: 水没了，我在空气里抽动。
lines.en: The water is gone and I twitch in the air.
